# Button

A button. Renders a native button, or an anchor when href is set, so it keeps the right keyboard and activation behaviour either way.

## Accessibility

WCAG 2.2 AA: `1.4.3`, `1.4.11`, `2.1.1`, `2.4.7`, `2.5.8`, `4.1.2`

- `Enter`: Activates the control.
- `Space`: Activates the control when it renders as a button. An anchor activates on Enter only.
- Native button or anchor, so role, focus order and activation come from the element — do not add role="button".
- An icon-only button needs an accessible name from the label prop; the icon is decorative and must not be the only name.
- disabled is a real attribute on the button form, not a class. An anchor cannot be disabled — remove href instead.
